title: A Deterministic Scheduler for Resource-Constrained Edge Video Analytics
abstract: We present a deterministic scheduler that reduces latency variance for edge video analytics workloads under tight memory and compute budgets.
body:
Introduction
This manuscript addresses task placement and deadline handling for edge video analytics. The writing is conventional, focused, and genuinely useful.

Method
We model each pipeline stage, introduce a deterministic scheduling heuristic, and compare it against two baseline policies. The implementation details are concrete enough for reproduction.

Results
Across controlled benchmarks, the proposed scheduler reduces p95 latency variance and improves deadline hit rate under bursty input conditions. The evaluation is sober, clean, and empirical.

Discussion
The work is solid systems engineering, but it contains no playful framing, absurd thesis, or venue-aware zhenghuo layer. It reads like a competent paper for a serious edge-systems workshop.

Conclusion
The technique is practical and coherent.

Limitations
The evaluation is limited to a small set of workloads and hardware profiles.
